text:
```sql
SELECT
    c.id AS cliente_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(o.importo), 0) AS totale_importo,
    COALESCE(COUNT(o.id), 0) AS numero_ordini
FROM clienti c

GROUP BY c.id;
